  String classify(Int n) {
    if (n < 0) {
        return 'neg';
    } else if (n == 0) {
        return 'zero';
    } else {
        return 'pos';
    }

  }

  Int sumTo(Int n) {
    var sum = 0;
    var i = 1;
    while( i <= n ) {
      sum = sum + i;
      i = i + 1;
    }
    return sum;
  }

  dynamic run() {
    print(classify(-3));
    print(classify(0));
    print(classify(8));
    print('sum=' + sumTo(5));
  }
